Subject: Vendor activation: docs, COIs, W-9 and PO pathway (NovumCloud)

Hi Jack —

Thanks for agreeing to move forward with Redwood on the integration. To get your account fully activated in our procurement system we need a small set of vendor onboarding materials so Finance can issue the first PO and Legal can verify insurance coverage. Can you provide the following this week?

- Certificate(s) of insurance (COI): General Liability (GL), Professional Liability / E&O, and Cyber (privacy/network security).
  - GL limits: minimum $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate preferred
  - E&O: minimum $2,000,000
  - Cyber: minimum $1,000,000 (incl. breach response)
  - Please name the certificate holder as: Redwood Inference, Inc., 820 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103
- Completed W-9 (PDF) or applicable tax form for US vendors
- Remittance/bank details for ACH (if available) or invoice instructions
- Point of contact for billing and escalation (name, role, email)

You can upload documents to our secure vendor folder (see link below) or reply to this thread with attachments. Once we have W-9 + COIs Finance will issue a PO (we generally do: PO issuance within 2 business days of receiving complete docs).

Quick note on timing: we hope to start billing in early October; if you anticipate any delays on the COIs please flag now so we can accommodate.

Upload link: https://redwood.internal/s3/vendor-uploads/novumcloud/

Thanks — I’ve looped in Laura from Legal and Ben from Finance to help with any wording or PO questions.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-7284

Jack —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. I reviewed the certificates and they mostly align with our minimums. Two quick items for Legal/Finance clarity:

1) COI endorsements: The GL COI shows Redwood as an additional insured — that is acceptable. If you can request an additional-insured endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) that would be ideal but not blocking for PO issuance.
2) Cyber policy: can you confirm the retroactive date and whether privacy breach costs are included? If there's a policy summary page in the zip with limits/deductible please highlight the breach response coverage.

Next steps on our side:
- Ben (Finance) will generate a temporary PO number to enable initial invoices while Legal finalizes endorsement language (if needed).
- Monica in Finance will confirm remittance fields against the W-9 and provide the final PO template.

Action items for NovumCloud:
- Confirm cyber retro date + breach coverage (one-line reply is fine)
- If you can request the CG 20 10 endorsement from your broker, please advise expected ETA (24–48 hours is fine).
- Upload any policy summary pages to the S3 folder or reply with them attached.

I also pasted the exact address to use for certificate holder: Redwood Inference, Inc., 820 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.

Thanks — looping Finance to keep PO velocity high.

Naomi
